name: makarasty-tools
description: Nine small commands that travel with the fleet plugin but are versioned apart from it: commit under your own name, ship (merge branches in, split the work into your own commits, push, tag with patch notes), review a diff and report only findings with evidence, or loop until none are left, hand a chat's work to a fresh chat as a chip or pick up another chat's work from its history, collect dictated bugs quietly until a codeword, explain where things stand in plain words, strip assistant tics out of writing, say what you mean in simple English a person can read aloud to a vendor, and get one message on your phone when a chat you walked away from finishes. A hook reminds a chat to offer a handoff once its context passes 400k tokens.
